recoveryRecommendations.action: No recovery needed before the final allocator pass.

recoveryPlan.trigger: estimated packed bank reaches warning threshold or any package is over one 8 KB window
recoveryPlan.action: Re-run first-fit-decreasing with final stored sizes after ZX0 policy decisions.

recoveryPlan.trigger: independently addressable world/screen/sprite package is too large or near the bank limit
recoveryPlan.action: Split the logical world package across additional physical world data banks.

recoveryPlan.trigger: resident or manifest data creates bank pressure
recoveryPlan.action: Move cold read-only tables out of resident/core placement and into world data banks.

recoveryPlan.trigger: large load-to-VRAM screen, pattern, color, tilemap, or sprite data creates pressure
recoveryPlan.action: Try ZX0 only for large load-to-VRAM resources; keep runtime lookup data raw.

recoveryPlan.trigger: runtime table is tiny, mutable, or accessed in hot loops
recoveryPlan.action: Do not solve ROM pressure by decompressing whole worlds into RAM or by compressing hot per-frame tables.

recoveryPlan.trigger: rare behavior or boss-specific code contributes to resident pressure
recoveryPlan.action: Move rare behavior behind a world special-code bank and far-call boundary.

recoveryPlan.trigger: single screen/graphics payload cannot fit one mapper window as a unit
recoveryPlan.action: Split large screen or graphics payloads into loader-addressable chunks only when each chunk is independently referenced.

recoveryPlan.trigger: all deterministic recovery attempts still leave an over-budget unit
recoveryPlan.action: Fail before Glass with largest contributors and concrete authoring changes.

logicalBankBudget.note: Logical pre-pack budget by asset package with first-fit-decreasing estimate. Final allocator still decides physical Konami 8K placement after compression.
